propositions: Preview and legacy --mode dry-run passes perform undocumented remote Jira writes (add_label, set_entity_property) during pending-binding recovery despite being documented as no-write modes.

The recovery gate in run_differs._run_differs_outbound conditions only on scoped_ids, omitting the persist axis; sibling gates (invariant_filing, repair_at_write_boundary) correctly compose both axes.
On an unscoped no-write pass, the keyed-pending recovery branch executes and issues real client.add_label() and client.set_entity_property() mutations to remote issues.
The fix suppresses remote recovery writes on persist=False passes by adding ctx.persist to the recovery gate, matching how preview suppresses other mutations and keeping live-pass recovery unchanged.
